title: Concept: Insert identifier returned to the client
description: The database identifier assigned to a newly created row in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The identifier exposes the insert order and the sequence behind it, which is the value an attacker needs to walk neighbouring records.
applicability: Deployments that render the database identifier assigned to a newly created row into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The identifier exposes the insert order and the sequence behind it, which is the value an attacker needs to walk neighbouring records.
